headerDisplay: Connect Nuheat Signature floor-heating thermostats to HomeKit. Most users only need their MyNuheat account email and password.
footerDisplay: The npm package is homebridge-nuheat2, but the Homebridge platform remains NuHeat for backward compatibility.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Homebridge platform identifier. Keep this set to NuHeat.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Display name used for this platform instance in Homebridge logs.

email.title: MyNuheat Email
email.description: Email address for the MyNuheat account that owns the thermostats.

devices.title: Thermostat Allow-List
devices.description: Optional. Leave empty to expose every thermostat on the account. Add rows only if you want to limit HomeKit to specific thermostat serial numbers.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Keep this row in the config but do not expose this thermostat.

groups.title: Away Mode Group Allow-List
groups.description: Optional. Leave empty unless you want specific Nuheat groups exposed as away-mode switches. Away mode is applied by Nuheat's servers; affected thermostats may be reported as being in Standby rather than Away.

groupName.title: Group Name
groupName.description: Group name exactly as shown in MyNuheat.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Keep this row in the config but do not expose this group.

autoPopulateAwayModeSwitches.title: Expose Away Mode Switches For All Groups
autoPopulateAwayModeSwitches.description: Automatically create HomeKit away-mode switches for every Nuheat group on the account. Away mode is applied by Nuheat's servers; affected thermostats may be reported as being in Standby rather than Away.

exposeScheduleSwitches.title: Expose Schedule Switches
exposeScheduleSwitches.description: Create one switch per thermostat. The switch is on when the thermostat follows its Nuheat schedule and can be turned on to resume the schedule.

holdLength.title: Hold Length (minutes)
holdLength.description: Duration for HomeKit setpoint changes. Use 0 to hold until the next scheduled event, 1-1439 for a timed hold, or 1440 for a permanent hold.

refresh.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
refresh.description: How often to poll Nuheat as a safety net. Notifications update faster when enabled; avoid very low values to reduce API traffic.

enableNotifications.title: Enable Nuheat Notifications
enableNotifications.description: Use Nuheat SignalR notifications for faster updates. Disable only while troubleshooting, which leaves polling as the fallback.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logs
debug.description: Write detailed Nuheat API and accessory activity to the Homebridge log.

layout.title: Accessories
layout.description: Control which Nuheat thermostats and group switches appear in HomeKit.

layout.title: Behavior
layout.description: Tune holds, refresh behavior, notifications, and logging.
